task_scope: Official ready-made bulk professor/faculty historical catalogue route only; no individual record or birth-date research.

route.name: ACAD — A Cambridge Alumni Database
route.institution: University of Cambridge / Cambridge University Library
route.source_family: Alumni Cantabrigienses (Venn), Emden, Newnham and Girton registers
route.population_description: People academically associated with Cambridge; students, graduates and office-holders are mixed.
route.period_description: Academic-association/source coverage approximately 1200–1900; this is not a birth-year range.
route.historical_years_note: The route includes medieval and early modern records, many potentially earlier than a modern birth-window requirement; no birth-window or professor-role filtering was performed.
route.date_precision_note: Public form explicitly warns of approximate lifespans, ±10-year margins, and for pre-1752 men possible admission-date ±100-year substitutes. These must not be treated as explicit birthdates.
route.availability_conclusion: None of the three inspected official pages supplied a directly usable whole-table/text/download containing confirmed name + explicit birthdate + professor role. This bounded check does not prove that no public bulk release exists elsewhere.

other_leads_not_opened.note: Official Cambridge guide points to ACAD and digitized matriculation/degree books via Internet Archive; no bulk dataset or professor role filter verified.

stop_reason: No direct public bulk acquisition route established within the authorized check. Stopped without per-person checks, result-page scraping, endpoint probing or additional source requests.
